science_relevance.scientific_problem: Minimize the length of a tour that visits each location once and returns to its start.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Shorter feasible tours address routing, inspection and manufacturing movement costs. The local instances are bounded algorithmic studies of that operations-research objective, not evidence of a deployed logistics improvement.

papers.task_relation: Helsgaun develops a solver whose central goal is shorter symmetric TSP tours. Traveling salesman constructive heuristic uses its own construction, search, or attention interface and instance distribution while optimizing that same feasible-tour objective.

Using a task to evaluate an agent, framework, or general-purpose model, or citing only a benchmark, dataset, or tool, does not establish scientific importance.
